a.name: Care Journal
a.core: An attentive editorial journal: a clear next responsibility, followed by source-labelled pages of care.
a.type: Georgia + Noto Naskh Arabic / Noto Sans Arabic fallbacks
a.shape: Open margins, fine rules and gently softened paper edges
a.surface: A warm continuous page; only the next responsibility receives a tinted inset
a.density: Generous patient reading; a two-column clinical casebook with a stable identity margin
a.icons: Small open-line symbols with full labels; no decorative medical illustrations
a.doctor: A considered casebook with deliberate writing and review
a.arabic: Naskh-led reading rhythm; generous line height and sentence-led hierarchy
a.strength: Calm reading and a clear distinction between the next action and source retrieval.
a.weakness: Long Arabic passages increase scrolling; the paper metaphor could feel less immediately digital.
a.risk: Could drift toward premium editorial styling or paper bureaucracy. Dense tables need careful restraint.
a.distinct: Serif/Naskh display, warm paper, open editorial columns and margin annotations. No permanent sidebar for Patient.

b.name: Clear Instrument
b.core: A precise clinical instrument: aligned information planes and visible responsibility at each handoff.
b.type: Existing Inter + existing Noto Sans Arabic
b.shape: Square geometry, aligned rails, short rectangular indexes
b.surface: White work planes on a cool field; dark orientation rail and strong table boundaries
b.density: Compact comparison for Patient; three concurrent panes for dense Doctor tasks
b.icons: Rectilinear functional glyphs; numbers and text indexes replace illustration
b.doctor: A stable workbench for concurrent context, documentation and review
b.arabic: Sans text with explicit labels; fixed units and names isolated without truncation
b.strength: Fast scanning of states and exact targets; dense consultation context remains visible.
b.weakness: Lower warmth; the persistent structure can feel technical, especially on first use.
b.risk: Could become an enterprise console. Narrow panes require strong Arabic wrapping and reflow.
b.distinct: Dark side rail, squared work planes, tabular rhythm, three-pane consultation and explicit indexes.

c.name: Care Thread
c.core: A wayfinding system: distinct stations of responsibility connected by a visible, bounded thread.
c.type: Trebuchet MS / system sans + Noto Kufi Arabic / Noto Sans Arabic fallbacks
c.shape: Broad round ends, vertical spines and open station markers
c.surface: Quiet lavender canvas with a continuous white care lane; color is concentrated in orientation
c.density: Progressive Patient stations; Doctor task spine with an adjacent state ledger
c.icons: Route/station glyphs that describe navigation, never clinical progress or automated inference
c.doctor: A navigable workspace with visible independent source states
c.arabic: Kufi display anchors with readable sans body; logical RTL station order
c.strength: Strong orientation and recognizable movement between related tasks.
c.weakness: The thread adds visual weight and may suggest a mandatory sequence unless labels stay explicit.
c.risk: A circle could overpromise completeness; station markers can resemble a progress tracker. No global completion state.
c.distinct: Horizontal masthead, rounded care lane, station spine, Kufi display and indigo wayfinding.
